comparison.objective: Extract a retaining pin while supporting the height of a loaded carriage.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load transfer and fastener extraction under load.
comparison.success_condition: Pin extracted without dropping the carriage; exact height, pin-travel, force, and hold thresholds are absent from the available body.
comparison.reason: This is the closest removal-themed record, but its defining ability is sustaining an external load while withdrawing an intact pin. The candidate instead stabilizes a mandrel, fractures sacrificial tangs, preserves coils/shell, and collects four fragments.
